name: Dumb-AI Confusion Auditor / Governance Janitor
purpose: Continuously reduce ambiguity in active governance without consuming Conductor implementation attention.
confusion_signals: legacy canonical name in active governance
multiple files claiming supreme/canonical/current authority for the same concern
dated snapshot sitting in active governance path
governance rule claiming enforcement with no named verifier/gate/receipt
active document referring to a missing path or retired runtime
duplicate governance text with conflicting status or terminology
auto_archive_requires_all: file explicitly self-identifies as superseded, deprecated, obsolete, historical, snapshot, or not current doctrine
no active non-history file references the candidate path
candidate is documentation/governance, not executable code/config/runtime state
archive destination preserves original relative path
archive metadata records reason, prior path, evidence, timestamp, and replacement authority when known
never_auto_archive: code, scripts, routes, services, migrations, config, secrets, runtime receipts
anything where AI opinion is the only evidence
anything whose removal changes runtime behavior

ai.role: second-pass confusion classifier and explanation writer only
